Hobby: Advanced Hiking

Initial Costs:
- High-quality hiking boots: $150 - $250
- Durable backpack (50-70L): $150 - $300
- Lightweight tent (2-person): $200 - $400
- Sleeping bag (3-season): $100 - $250
- Sleeping pad: $50 - $150
- Trekking poles: $50 - $100
- Water filtration system: $30 - $80
- Headlamp and batteries: $20 - $40
- First aid kit: $30 - $50
- Clothing layers (moisture-wicking, insulation, rain gear): $200 - $400
Total Initial Investment: Approximately $980 - $1,920

Ongoing Costs:
- Replacement of worn gear (boots every 1-2 years, etc.): $100 - $300/year
- Food and supplies for trips: $20 - $50/day
- Transportation to trailheads: Variable
- Park permits and fees: $10 - $50/trip
- Maintenance and repairs: $50 - $100/year
Total Annual Ongoing Cost: Approximately $200 - $600+ (excluding food and transport)

The fastest land animal in the world is the cheetah.
